request: mix: テキスト中のIPv4を/24ごとにまとめ指定幅で折り返して一覧にする / ファイルまたは標準入力のテキストからIPv4アドレスを正規表現で抜き出し、重複を除いて、-p で指定したプレフィックス長（8、16、24のいずれか、既定は24）ごとにグループ化する。各グループを「10.0.1.: 5 12 33 ...」のように共通部分の後に残りの数字を昇順で並べ、-w で指定した表示幅（既定80）を超える場合は折り返して、2行目以降は先頭の見出し分だけインデントする。例：ログに 10.0.1.5、10.0.1.33、10.0.2.7、10.0.1.12 が出てくる場合、「10.0.1.: 5 12 33」と「10.0.2.: 7」の2行を出力する。コマンド名は ipfold

spec.name: ipfold
spec.summary: ipfold extracts unique IPv4 addresses from text and prints them grouped by prefix, wrapped to a given width.
behavior: B1: Input is the concatenation of all files named as arguments, in order; with no file arguments it is read from stdin.

B2: Addresses are found with the regexp [0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+ (leftmost, non-overlapping matches). A match is kept only if every octet has 1 to 3 digits and a decimal value of at most 255; otherwise it is ignored. Octets are printed as plain decimal integers.

B4: With -p 8, 16 or 24 the heading of an address is its first 1, 2 or 3 octets, each followed by a dot, then a colon (e.g. "10.0.1.:"). The value is the remaining octets joined by dots (e.g. "5", "1.5", "0.1.5").

B5: One group per distinct heading prefix. Groups are ordered ascending by the numeric octets of the prefix; values within a group are ordered ascending, comparing the remaining octets numerically one by one.
B6: A group is printed as the heading, then for each value a single space and the value, then a newline. Lengths are counted in bytes.

B7: Wrapping: the first value always stays on the heading line. For each later value, if current line length + 1 + value length is greater than the -w width, the line ends with a newline and a new line starts with (heading length + 1) spaces followed by the value; otherwise a space and the value are appended. Values are never split.
B8: If no addresses are found, nothing is printed and the exit code is 0.
B9: If -p is not 8, 16 or 24, or -w is less than 1, print "ipfold: " followed by a message to stderr and exit 2. Unknown flags are usage errors (exit 2).
B10: If a file cannot be read, print "ipfold: " followed by the error to stderr, continue with the remaining files, print results for the readable input, and exit 1.
